ITA-5.64.24 unmathakaḥ उन्मथकः
Painless oedema of ear lobule
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: its association with itching; rigid swelling; painless swelling.

ITA-9.6.31 unmathanakarma उन्मथनकर्म
Extraction by twisting or stirring
An extraction procedure to remove an impacted foreign body.

ITA-9.2.32 unmardanam उन्मर्दनम्
Manual massage in ascending direction
A therapeutic massage of the body parts with gentle strokes applied in the ascending direction with the masseur’s palms.

ITA-5.28.1 unmādaḥ उन्मादः
Psychosis
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a confused state of mind; altered state of judgement; altered consiousness/peripheral sensations; altered memory; altered desire/likings; impaired character; agitated activities; impaired behaviour; confused intellect; fickleness of mind; perplexed appearance; restlessness; incoherent speech; loneliness/lack of alertness; feeling of pain in body; feeling of happiness in body; undertaking activities without any forethought; sudden lack of happiness; sudden lack of sorrow; sudden loss of righteous things; sudden loss of nonrighteous things; wandering abruptly.

unmārgagāmībhagandaraḥ/ śalyajanyabhagandaraḥ/ kṣatajabhagandaraḥ उन्मार्गगामीभगन्दरः/ शल्यजन्यभगन्दरः/ क्षतजभगन्दरः
Anal fistula formed due to foreign body
A fistula characterized by putrefaction of muscle associated with pus and blood; resembling worms generated in moist soil; microorganisms damaging soft tissue of anal region; gases; urine; faeces and semen emanating from the tracts created by microorganisms.

.21 Unmeṣiṇīsirā उन्मेषिणीसिरा
Nerves involved in eyelid opening
